name: HSE — how to get assessed for autism
description: HSE public guidance on how children and adults in the Republic of Ireland can start exploring autism assessment and what support may be available while waiting.
intended_use: Use as the national Republic-of-Ireland starting route for autism-assessment access, including the current adult public/private distinction.
audience_or_context: Children and adults in the Republic of Ireland, and people supporting them.
limitations: HSE states it does not currently provide autism assessments for adults; this is an access fact, not a judgment about whether an individual should seek diagnosis.
Child referral destinations and waits can vary by needs and local service organisation.
The page does not establish the quality or suitability of any private assessor.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; adult autism assessment currently requires paying for a private assessment according to the reviewed HSE page.
conflicts_of_interest: HSE describes the public system it operates; ND Oracle records the official access route without assuming service availability, clinical outcome or provider quality.

provenance.method: HSE autism assessment page checked on 2026-09-04 for Republic-of-Ireland child/adult access, current adult private-access statement and support-without-diagnosis wording. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
